descriptionHtml:
Gigabyte B850M DS3H Motherboard

​The Gigabyte B850M DS3H is a Micro-ATX motherboard built on the AMD AM5 socket. It is designed to support AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors, offering a balance of performance and future-proof connectivity including PCIe 5.0 support.

​General Specifications

  • ​Chipset: AMD B850
  • ​Socket: AM5
  • ​Form Factor: Micro-ATX
  • ​CPU Support: AMD Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series

​Memory (RAM)

  • ​Type: Dual Channel DDR5
  • ​Slots: 4 x DIMM
  • ​Max Capacity: Up to 256 GB
  • ​Speeds: Supports up to DDR5 8200 (OC)
  • ​Profiles: Supports AMD EXPO and Intel XMP memory modules

​Expansion & Storage

  • ​PCIe Slots:
    • ​1 x PCIe 5.0 x16 (Primary graphics card slot)
    • ​1 x PCIe 3.0 x4
  • ​M.2 Slots (SSD):
    • ​1 x M.2 supporting PCIe 5.0 x4
    • ​1 x M.2 supporting PCIe 4.0 x4
  • ​SATA: 4 x SATA 6Gb/s connectors

​Power & Cooling

  • ​VRM Design: 8+2+2 Twin Digital VRM phases for stable power delivery.
  • ​Thermals: Heatsinks for MOSFETs and an M.2 Thermal Guard for the primary SSD.
  • ​Fan Headers: Supports PWM/DC fans and water cooling pump configurations.

​Connectivity & I/O (Rear Panel)

  • ​Video Outputs: 1 x HDMI 2.1, 2 x DisplayPort 1.4
  • ​USB Ports:
    • ​1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C
    • ​1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A
    • ​2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1
    • ​4 x USB 2.0
  • ​Networking: Realtek 2.5GbE LAN
  • ​Audio: Realtek Audio CODEC (7.1 Channel support)
  • ​Q-Flash Plus: Dedicated button to update BIOS without installing CPU, RAM, or GPU.

​Key Highlights

  • ​Next-Gen Ready: Features PCIe 5.0 for both the primary GPU slot and one M.2 slot to handle ultra-fast data speeds.
  • ​EZ-Latch: Simplifies hardware installation with tool-less mechanisms for PCIe and M.2 components.
  • ​Performance Tuning: Includes specialized BIOS modes like "X3D Turbo Mode" to maximize gaming performance on compatible Ryzen processors.
